structured_output.rationale: All three lines denied CO-4/N822: therapy CPTs 97530, 97140, 97112 billed with KX only — GP (physical therapy plan of care) is absent. CO-4 = returned unprocessable; new original claim required. Chart note confirms PT services. DOS 2026-07-25; Medicare 1-year filing limit runs to 2027-07-25.

root_cause.explanation: Lines 1–3 carry KX but no GP modifier. CPTs 97530, 97140, 97112 require a therapy-discipline modifier (GP for PT plan of care). CO-4 + N822 = returned unprocessable.

next_action.detail: Submit a new original claim (CLM05-3=1, no REF*F8) adding GP to all three lines alongside KX. Do not appeal — CO-4/N822 is unprocessable with no appeal rights. File before 2027-07-25.
